format: 'LOG nn' = start page number in manifest order; '.1' first hop, '.2' STOP and loops, '.3' busiest edge, '.<group>' start x condition group (n >= 10 runs)

definitions.first_hop: k/m: runs whose first move went to the top link / runs whose first action is following a link; excluded from m: first action STOP, capsule-task runs (tc-*); GPT-4.1 runs (10) and blank-page search runs are not in the population. n runs = runs from the start by the 8 models before those exclusions. Identical to first_hops.json (asserted).
definitions.readers: share of Wikimedia clickstream listed clicks (Sep 2026) from the start page that go to that link, over the step-1 menu
definitions.loop: path contains A,B,A,B (three consecutive back-and-forth moves)
definitions.stop: run terminated by model STOP (termination model_stopped); denominator = runs where STOP was offered
